tools.name: create_race_plan
tools.description: Primary CourseProfiler tool for creating a personalized race plan and optional PDF. Use this after obtaining both a course input and runner input. Course input may be course_file, course.source with kind=url/artifact/raw_file, or course.crsprof_artifact_id. Do not use raw_json or reconstruct/synthes

tools.name: search_race_catalog
tools.description: Search CourseProfiler's race catalog by race/course name and return direct CRSProf URLs that can be used as course sources.

tools.name: import_course
tools.description: Import a fetchable official GPX/FIT/CRSProf URL, official ZIP containing exactly one GPX, uploaded source_file artifact, raw JSON payload, or inline/proxied course_file into a CRSProf artifact. tools.name: generate_course_segments

tools.name: generate_runner_profile
tools.description: Generate a segment-evidence USRProf runner profile artifact from uploaded runner evidence or an existing .usrprof source. Confirm profile purpose and evidence selection only if not already explicit. Do not silently use every local file. profile_intent is advisory: the server does not filter sources.

tools.name: submit_course
tools.description: Submit an official/trusted course for CourseProfiler catalog review. tools.name: get_course_submission_requirements
tools.description: Use this before submit_course when the user gives only a race name or incomplete inputs. Returns the catalog-first course submission workflow, accepted route sources, metadata, waypoint enrichment, and upload requirements.

tools.name: get_race_plan_requirements
tools.description: Use this before create_race_plan when the user gives only a race name or incomplete inputs. Returns the required course and runner inputs and the next steps an assistant should take, including catalog matches when available.

tools.name: get_runner_profile_requirements
tools.description: Use this when runner input is missing or unclear. Explains how to obtain or generate runner input, what USRProf/evidence files should contain, whether GPX/FIT activities are enough, and how hosted MCP clients should upload artifacts.

tools.name: get_artifact_upload_requirements
tools.description: Use this when an assistant needs instructions for CourseProfiler's REST artifact upload flow or needs to explain why hosted MCP cannot upload bare local paths. This is an instruction helper, not a raw-byte MCP upload tool.

tools.name: get_job
tools.description: Poll a CourseProfiler async job by job_id.

tools.name: get_artifact
tools.description: Fetch artifact metadata and a private short-lived download URL by artifact_id. Artifact download URLs are private and short-lived; share them only with the user, verbatim in a code block, not a clickable link. Ask the user to copy the entire URL into their browser address bar. Do not rewrite the URL

tools.name: validate_course_profile
tools.description: Validate a CRSProf artifact or inline CRSProf JSON before race planning or catalog submission. This does not mutate artifacts or submit courses.

tools.name: validate_runner_profile
tools.description: Validate a USRProf artifact or inline USRProf JSON before creating personalized race plans. This does not mutate artifacts or generate a new profile.

tools.name: export_race_plan_pdf
tools.description: Export a Hi-Fi PDF or standalone checkpoint card from an existing CRSProf artifact. tools.description: Build a USRProf from Strava activities selected for a target course or distance. findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: create_race_plan, search_race_catalog, import_course, submit_course, get_artifact, analyze_activity, inspect_runner_profile · Private data: create_race_plan, import_course, generate_runner_profile, submit_course, get_runner_profile_requirements, get_artifact, export_race_plan_pdf, build_runner_profile_from_strava, analyze_activity, inspect_runner_profile, assess_finish_time_goal, compare_pacing_strategies, import_profile_attachment · Public sink: create_race_plan, import_course, generate_course_segments, generate_runner_profile, submit_course, get_course_submission_requirements, get_runner_profile_requirements, get_artifact_upload_requirements, get_artifact, validate_course_profile, analyze_activity, inspect_runner_profile, import_profile_attachment · Destructive: submit_course, export_race_plan_pdf, inspect_runner_profile.
